# Generated by GLAD 2.0.8 with the specification bundled in that release.
# Regenerate from the repository root with:
#   python3 -m pip install --user 'glad2==2.0.8'
#   python3 -m glad --api 'gl:core=3.3' --extensions '' --out-path third_party/glad --reproducible c

enable_language(C)

add_library(glad STATIC
    src/gl.c
)

add_library(glad::glad ALIAS glad)
add_library(Xora2D::Glad ALIAS glad)

target_include_directories(glad
    PUBLIC
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include
)

target_compile_features(glad PRIVATE c_std_11)

if(CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang|GNU")
    target_compile_options(glad PRIVATE -w)
endif()
